import click
ctx = click.Context(click.Command('test'))
option = click.Option(['--feature/--no-feature', '-f/-F'])
assert option.get_error_hint(ctx) == "'--feature' / '-f'"
assert option.get_error_hint(ctx, include_secondary=False) == "'--feature' / '-f'"
assert option.get_error_hint(ctx, include_secondary=True) == "'--feature' / '-f' / '--no-feature' / '-F'"
assert option.opts == ['--feature', '-f']
option.opts = []
assert option.get_error_hint(ctx) == "'feature'"
assert option.get_error_hint(ctx, include_secondary=True) == "'--no-feature' / '-F'"
option.secondary_opts = []
assert option.get_error_hint(ctx, include_secondary=True) == "'feature'"
try:
    option.get_error_hint(ctx, True)
except TypeError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('include_secondary must be keyword-only')
print('Focused checks passed')
